3.14 Ἀφρικανοῦ· βάμμα τριχῶν αἰωνίως
φυλαττόμενον Σφέκλης, ἀκακίας μελαίνης, στυπτηρίας στρογγύλης, πολυτρίχου,
ἀνὰ ˉγˉο ʹ, κηκῖδος στατ. βʹ κερατ. ʹ κάρυα χλωρὰ ιʹ, μυρσίνης μελαίνης ἀφ' αἵματος
ˉλˉι α#161ʹ, λαδάνου ˉγˉο ʹ, οἴνου παλαιοῦ μέλανος ˉλˉι εʹ. Ἕψει πάντα μετὰ οἴνου
ἕως ἀποτριτωθῇ, καὶ προσμήξας ἔμβαπτε τὰς τρίχας νυχθήμερα γʹ καὶ θαυμάσεις.
pass_a_gloss: 3.14 Of-Africanus: a-dye of-hairs eternally being-guarded. Of-lees, of-acacia black, of-alum round, of-polytrichon, of-each ounce 1, of-oak-gall staters 2 keration 1, walnuts green 10, of-myrtle black from blood [lock measure unrestored], of-ladanum ounce 1, of-wine old black litrai 5. Boil all with wine until it-be-reduced-to-a-third, and having-mixed-on dip the hairs nychthemera 3 and you-will-wonder.
pass_b_english: Of Africanus: a dye of hairs guarded eternally. Of lees, of black acacia, of round alum, of polytrichon, of each one ounce; of oak-gall two staters and one keration; ten green walnuts; of black myrtle from blood [lock measure unrestored]; of ladanum one ounce; of old black wine five litrai. Boil all with wine until it is reduced to a third, and having mixed it in, dip the hairs three nychthemera, and you will wonder.

choices.english: until it is reduced to a third
choices.why: ἀποτριτόω is boil-down to one third, not 'until three times'.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
